source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check GPU Memory-Utilization via cmd: nvidia-smi --format=csv --query-gpu=utilization.memory

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. All GPUs' Memory-Utilization should be expected.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; correct read-only field but lacks workload/sampling context and could be confused with memory capacity usage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / IMPROVED; identifies memory-controller utilization semantics and adds UUID, workload, driver-specific policy and time series.

original_test_intent: Measure the NVIDIA-reported memory-controller utilization of every required GPU under a defined workload and confirm the time-series behavior satisfies the project policy.
original_method: Run the source utilization.memory query, bind each sample to UUID/Bus-Id/time and workload phase, preserve driver/architecture context, and compare the approved series without confusing it with framebuffer memory.used.
manual_activity: Engineering supplies the workload and expected memory-controller utilization policy. Collection and evaluation are machine-executable; the case does not authorize generating load or changing GPU state.
required_inputs: Architecture/driver-specific expected utilization range or behavior
safety_requirements: Use read-only nvidia-smi; do not launch/kill workloads or change clocks, power, persistence or reset state.
Label utilization.memory as memory-controller activity, not allocated memory capacity.
Preserve timestamp, stable identity, N/A/outlier/error and workload context.
Do not extend or repeat the collection automatically after an unexpected result.
agent_execution_scope: Collect stable identity, tool/driver/architecture and workload/process context.
Execute the exact source field at the approved cadence with raw outputs/return codes.
Apply the supplied policy per GPU and report Tool Result without formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Define/approve workload, sampling and architecture-specific acceptance policy.
Interpret unsupported metrics or workload transients.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field is directly applicable but reports controller utilization, not framebuffer occupancy; a single context-free value cannot satisfy `expected`.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain utilization.memory and collect an approved UUID/time/workload-correlated series; use memory.used only in its separate testcase.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The utilization.memory field and both 1-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a timestamped per-UUID controller-utilization series aligned to workload phases and evaluated with architecture/driver-specific rules.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: NVIDIA GPUs/driver versions that expose utilization.memory through NVML.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record driver, nvidia-smi/NVML, GPU architecture/firmware, OS and workload versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA System Management Interface documentation for the deployed driver and project workload policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds semantic labeling, identity and time/workload context without changing the field.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sampling semantics and support can vary by architecture/virtualization; N/A must not be coerced to zero.

project_override_considerations: A project may set idle/load phases and sampling duration. It must not report utilization.memory as percentage of capacity used or generalize a one-minute phase to other workloads.
expected_evidence: Declared workload/process state and approved sampling/policy
Raw timestamped utilization.memory CSV and exit codes
Per-GPU policy comparison with N/A/outliers retained
Final health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently uses the memory-utilization field. Missing semantic thresholds are project readiness inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only sampling is safe; missing workload/policy affects interpretation only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the field but prevents confusion with allocated memory and adds context.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with FULLY AUTOMATABLE and retains UUID/workload/sampling/driver-policy safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates this controller activity metric from adjacent memory.used and preserves no-unapproved-workload scope.

review_improvement: Prevents a controller-busy percentage from being mislabeled as memory capacity consumption and makes dynamic evidence reproducible.
independent_technical_reasoning: This telemetry is machine-readable and can be evaluated automatically after project parameters are supplied; those parameters do not create a manual core or a permanent block.

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat/extend sampling, start/kill workload or reset GPU automatically after an unexpected or unsupported metric.
